messages:
nicole.k: heads-up — I found KMS-wrapped blobs in partner_s3/backups/onboarding-2026-03-18.tar.gz. They look like base64 blobs that unwrap with redwood-prod-kms. unsure if they contain long-lived Vault tokens or ephemeral creds.

mattg: wtf. where did the backup come from? automated job?

nicole.k: looks like the onboarding script (tools/onboard/docker-entrypoint.sh) was tarring /tmp and uploading. dev infra created the bucket for partner work.

tara.s: can someone run `aws s3 cp s3://partner_s3/backups/onboarding-2026-03-18.tar.gz - | tar -tz` and grep for \"eyJ\" (base64 jwt-ish)?

infra-bot: run started by mattg: s3 ls s3://partner_s3/backups/ && aws s3 cp ... (truncated)

mattg: ran it, found files: creds.json, kv-dump.enc, session_blob.b64

nicole.k: session_blob.b64 looks like `aws-encryption-sdk` output wrapped to our KMS key. decrypted payload includes `VAULT_TOKEN=` and a postgres connection URL.

sec-bot: incident created INC-2026-145 (severity: high) — secret exposure discovered.

olivia.p: tagging product/security + partner-eng. partner-eng needs to know if this bucket contained customer PII.

nicole.k: quick mitigation: 1) replace bucket policy to deny GetObject except from infra CI for 1h; 2) delete the specific backup object; 3) rotate any service principal that could use the token.

mattg: agreed. I've revoked the service account that runs the onboarding job (svc-onboard-prod).

tara.s: creating a scoped Vault token rotation job — we'll revoke any `/auth/token/accessors` matching the token fingerprint if present. who has the fingerprint?

nicole.k: I pulled the cleartext token id: hv-tok-9a3e. shared via DM to ops leads.

mattg: deleted object and replaced bucket policy. confirmed via s3 head-object -> 404 for the file.

sec-bot: audit log event: KMS Decrypt called 2026-03-18T21:12:03Z by svc-onboard-prod (request-id xxxxx).

olivia.p: we need scope: which other buckets have onboarding tar uploads? search all partner_* buckets for similar names and grep for \"session_blob.b64\".

mattg: running search across 30 partner buckets now.

infra-bot: found matches in partner_s3/backups/onboarding-2026-02-10.tar.gz and partner_s3/backups/onboarding-2026-02-25.tar.gz (2 objects).

nicole.k: plan proposal: 1) rotate KMS data key alias redwood-prod-kms? NO — rotating key will break many things. Instead create new key redwood-onboard-ephemeral and rewrap any needed payloads; 2) full rotation of Vault tokens created by onboarding jobs; 3) tighten RBAC for onboarding job to remove kms:Decrypt for production KMS key; 4) add CI lint to prohibit writing clear tokens into /tmp in tar uploads.

tara.s: +1 on not rekeying redwood-prod-kms. we'll patch onboarding image to use ephemeral key for dumps going forward. ops to re-issue any DB creds that were in those blobs.

mattg: I've started rotating DB cred for onboarding-test (no customers). For prod DBs we need change window — pinging db-admins.

olivia.p: I'll notify partner-eng and legal if PII involved. We're also enabling object-level audit logs and extended retention for S3 access logs for these buckets.

nicole.k: security checklist for INC-2026-145: scope search results (mattg), delete objects (done), revoke svc-onboard-prod (done), rotate Vault tokens (tara.s), rotate any db creds (mattg/db-admins), update onboarding image and CI (infra), add RBAC change to deny kms:Decrypt on redwood-prod-kms for svc-onboard-prod (infra), postmortem in 72h.

tara.s: starting Vault token revocation run now. output: 3 accessors revoked, one token already expired.

mattg: db-admins scheduled prod rotation for 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC (low traffic).

olivia.p: legal confirmed no PII in the affected objects (only test accounts and a staging db URL).

nicole.k: thanks team. I'll own the postmortem and the PR to add the CI lint. please update INC-2026-145 ticket with your actions.

sec-bot: INC-2026-145 updated: objects deleted, svc account revoked, 3 vault tokens revoked, DB rotation scheduled.

mattg: all mitigation actions done. moving to remediation/lessons-learned phase.

olivia.p: closing loop with partner-eng (they will rotate their consumer keys as well).

nicole.k: marking this thread resolved for now. will publish follow-up with RBAC changes and CI rule tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
